requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1116-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1116-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

222-527-647-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-647-4247.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-7296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-3112-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2111-2511-6792.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4094-4365-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
4094-4365-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2653-2893-5478-7886.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

81-1017-2122.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Kami of Whispered Hopes
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-3668.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1090-1594-2146-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1303-2921-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing both Shambling Ghasts.
When the Shambling Ghasts die, they triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1368-5477-6321-6633.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-6633.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1543-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1543-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate a Planeswalker by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1978-5056-7488.description:
Cause Topiary Lecturer to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1806-1887-2060-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

851-2457-4289-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

3259-4460-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-4460-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4548-4871-5763.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Circle of the Land Druid, adding {C}{C}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability, Pitiless Plunderer and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Circle of the Land Druid trigger, returning Takenuma from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, returning Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Circle of the Land Druid by paying {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters, its first ability triggers, allowing you to mill four cards.
Repeat.

465-2921-3175.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

Your life total is at least 2.
5670-5933-6705.description:

When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

338-3490-4050-6823.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.

Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3334-3693-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

997-3197-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

513-527-5223.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.

513-527-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1737-2921-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

198-719-3767-3918.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
198-719-3767-3918.description:

Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.

880-2374-3470.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2820-3263-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {C}{C}.
When Lurrus dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Angelic Renewal from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

645-914-997-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-997-3750.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing you to scry 1.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

1594-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.

When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-3605-5145.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating a copy of any nonartifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Phyrexian Dreadnought trigger from sttep 2, doing nothing.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1021-2167-2653-4826.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

701-2290-4613.notablePrerequisites: Ajani's Pridemate has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
701-2290-4613.description:
Activate Ajani's Pridemate using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Ajani's Pridemate triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

1461-2034-3008.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1461-2034-3008.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Wurmcoil Engine.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm creature tokens.
Repeat.
